caption: A dim view is lit by a bright white-blue glare at the left edge. A hand from the right holds a small translucent square object between two fingers. The object stays near the center while the fingers tilt and rotate it through changing angles. Its face flares white, then shows warm yellow edges as the angle shifts. Later an internal diagonal pattern becomes visible through the translucent body. The hand blurs and withdraws to the right, leaving the square object in the center. It remains there, no longer held, with a warm reflection at its base.
relations: Fingers pinching the translucent square tilt and rotate it, changing its face angle against the left glare.
As the angle shifts, the face flare transitions from white to warm yellow edges, revealing an internal diagonal pattern.
The hand blurs and withdraws rightward, leaving the square centered and unsupported.
The released square persists at center, showing a warm reflection at its base.
